info.title: PadiCheck Backend API
info.description: Password + email OTP signup, Google identity, investigations, media and trust operations. Authenticate with a PadiCheck access token using Authorize. Roles, ownership and state transitions are enforced by the backend.

get.description: Liveness only; does not probe database or external services.
Checks database, enabled research registry and configured Redis resources. Configuration indicators do not prove live SMTP, Google or Cloudinary connectivity. Returns 503 when unavailable.

503.description: Service unavailable

post.summary: Start password signup and send email OTP
post.description: Start password signup. Queues a six-digit email code; 202 confirms queue acceptance, not inbox delivery. No account or token is created until verification. Code expires 10 minutes after the request, with five attempts, a 60-second resend cooldown and five requests per hour per email. Repeat this endpoint to resend. Existing accounts receive the same generic response. Requires Redis, SMTP configuration and a running email worker.
